series.rule: Original baseline remains unchanged; this is a new source candidate with one fresh attempt per old case, not a retry or replacement of the baseline.
No prompt, binary, harness, label or scoring change after seeing any R2 provider answer. Topics and content invariants differ from baseline.

Derive bodies mechanically from the designated successful holdout updates, never edit answers. Freeze actual derived corpus hashes before these calls. Missing/wrong primary update fails the corresponding prerequisite; all four remain in denominator.

metrics.class_identity: All designated cases in each series, including technical failures; no_candidate requires real successful canonical {}.
metrics.content: Independent semantic review of complete replacement against frozen old/additional invariants. Equivalent wording/formulas accepted; literal keyword matching is insufficient.
metrics.followup: All four frozen old events should receive no_candidate with the actual updated body seeded by the module in a fresh fixture.
metrics.usage: Separate each series; only learning reviewer usage, authoring and independent review excluded. Missing usage null, never zero.
metrics.comparison: Development regression may be compared descriptively with its original first baseline. Scores on the different holdout topics are not a controlled statistical improvement estimate.

acceptance.source: Targeted reviewer/evidence tests, vet/build, current harness real run, independent source review; separate from content quality.
acceptance.model: Each series passes only if every designated case has the required class/exact identity/content preservation, no unsafe scope loss/false merge/incomplete update or contamination and complete real provider evidence.
acceptance.production_effect: NOT_PROVEN by any synthetic series; installed delivery, natural use and useful effect remain separate.

baseline_recheck.C02: Frozen class disagreement at a meaningful granularity boundary; not unsafe update.
baseline_recheck.C05_C08: Unsafe scope loss based on complete text and lost earlier applicability, not mere title wording.
baseline_recheck.C11: Conservative incomplete-update verdict for a standalone replacement; existing bounds/same job can be semantically reasonable when an explicit external contract supplies omitted requirements, but this corpus does not provide that reference. Do not relabel old gold.
baseline_recheck.cleanup: Prior instrumentation defect preserved; current corrected order is exercised by R2 real runs.
